text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home from a trip out
with
Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh... Rain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without so much as a warning, rain
begins to
pour.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We dash inside the academy to escape
the
sudden deluge.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It came out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What should I do now? I was planning to
go for a
run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I could go back to my dorm, but it's so
boring.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Indoors... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of anything in particular. Do
you
have any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Now that you mention it,
we did get
a lot of homework today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was so excited to run in the nice
weather, I
wasn't paying much attention
in class...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... would you mind helping me out?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm not very good at studying on my
own...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I agree to lend Silence Suzuka a
hand
with her studies.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Let me make sure I understand.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To find the length, I have to apply this
formula,
right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Um... Now, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, maybe I'll have a bit of a mental
reset after
this question—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...So it is.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. I think... I've solved it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think I can solve the rest of
the
problems in the same way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But, um... Would you mind helping me
with
another subject?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to finish everything today so that
I can
make up for today's run tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you're here helping me, getting it all
out of the
way should be a piece of
cake.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Though I should warn you,
there is a
lot left.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A lot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We manage to finish all of her
homework, despite
it taking us until well
past sundown.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Cooking?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I usually only make rice balls to eat
while I run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can make anything more

complicated than that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right... If it will help me run
faster, I should
do it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gladly, if you would teach me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see. So running too much can cause
anemia...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And that means I should ensure I'm
consuming
lots of iron.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll go home and try it
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I tried what you told me and found this
recipe for
stir-fried liver and spinach. It
was easy to make,
and it's full of iron.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You should have some. It's good for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try out the food right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Natural? You mean...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh! I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I should have seasoned it for you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After a run, I tend to just focus on
getting the
nutrition I need. I guess that
mindset became the
norm for my
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-you think so?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll try making it again. I'll have Spe
taste-test it
too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So, I hope you'll agree to give it another
try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I have Silence Suzuka's
stir-fried
liver and spinach for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's turned out quite tasty this time. I can

definitely say she's made an
improvement.
